| description = Highly camped due to quest related items.

Exactly 7 Hour respawn with no placeholder. Located in the 'hidden' smuggler area. To reach him you must first swim through the underwater tunnel at (-158, 335) near the Tiger's Roar.

Notes:  One of the 'A Smuggler' is a drastic under-con.  He paths past Dyllin spawn and doubles for 120 dmg. Be prepared to die. 

Anecdote: After the 'A Smuggler' slaughtered a higher level player who was trying to kill Dyllin, the smuggler then aggro'd Dyllin, killing him quickly -- and of course the corpse vanished. So the smuggler(s) pathing past him need to be kept out of the fight altogether just to be safe.
